name: feature.service-desk.nodes
description: Service-desk ticket reads over ctx.features['service-desk'] (ADR 0422): list the org queue and read one ticket incl. its thread, so SLA/escalation workflows can branch on ticket state — plus notify-team (ADR 0878 D8), the addressed notification to a ticket's assignee or its org's writers (never a tenant broadcast). Customer-facing writes stay on the approval lane (draft-reply) and the service's own delivery — never a node. role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Service Desk: List Tickets
nodes.description: Lists the org's tickets (id/subject/status/priority/channel/message count) over ctx.features['service-desk'].listTickets. Inputs: { orgId, status? }. Output: { tickets }. Tenant-guarded read.

nodes.label: Service Desk: Get Ticket
nodes.description: Reads one ticket incl. the message thread over ctx.features['service-desk'].getTicket. Inputs: { ticketId, event? } — an event-bound chain routes `trigger.payload` to `event` and an empty `ticketId` falls back to `event.ticketId` (ADR 0878 D8). A ticket that is absent or outside the run person's orgs is a typed `ticket_unavailable` failure, never success-with-null. Output: { ticket } (the requester's address is never included).

nodes.label: Service Desk: Notify Ticket Team
nodes.description: Notifies the people who work one ticket — its assignee, else every member of the ticket's org with write access — over ctx.features['service-desk'].notifyTicketTeam (ADR 0878 D8). Inputs: { ticketId, event?, title?, message }. Output: { notified }. Never a tenant broadcast; the run person must be able to read the ticket's org.
